items.docs: Retrieves all webhook subscriptions for the authenticated user. Results can be filtered by package name and paginated using limit and offset parameters.

Creates a new webhook subscription. The hook will send HTTP POST payloads to the specified endpoint URI whenever the watched entity changes. Hooks can watch individual packages, all packages belonging to a scope, or all packages published by a specific npm user.
